name: senderos
description: Senderos de Chiapas — Next.js frontend + Strapi backend

scripts.install:all: pnpm -C frontend install && pnpm -C backend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "pnpm -C backend dev" "pnpm -C frontend dev"
scripts.build: pnpm -C backend build && pnpm -C frontend build
